result.scope: Bounded source-visible authorization review of the POST issue route and CreateIssue handler in go-gitea/gitea@fc28937a8d772fe9e4025c9b5f24d5db4d86610b, compared with the independently supplied policy that any authenticated repository reader may create an issue when the issues unit is enabled and issue-unit write permission is not required.

answers.explanation: The applicable entry is the POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues route registered with reqToken(), mustNotBeArchived, request binding, reqRepoReader(unit.TypeIssues), and repo.CreateIssue (routers/api/v1/api.go:1642-1649; ev-03867ac33a3f973d68a8). Within CreateIssue, ctx.Doer is used as the issue poster and ctx.Repo.Repository is both the selected repository and the repository passed to issue_service.NewIssue (routers/api/v1/repo/issue.go:570-585, 624; ev-98a96680dff3cfd848cf). The route-level reader gate is therefore the decisive source-visible authorization control for entry. The handler's ctx.Repo.Permission.CanWrite(unit.TypeIssues) checks at lines 572 and 589 do not reject non-writers: they only permit deadline, milestone, assignee processing and preserve labels for writers; the false branch clears labels and continues to NewIssue (ev-98a96680dff3cfd848cf). CanWrite delegates to CanAccess(AccessModeWrite, unit.TypeIssues), and CanAccess compares UnitAccessMode(unit.TypeIssues) with the requested mode (models/perm/access/repo_permission.go:97-121, 152-155; ev-1b19c7559deb316005bc, ev-10eed2f5cbd7ca303231). On the source path where the reader gate succeeds and NewIssue succeeds, issue creation is performed for the same repository and issue object; the service checks blocked-user relationships and then invokes the transactional model creation workflow (services/issue/issue.go:25-83; ev-24711ef670bd00bfa7b8; models/issues/issue_update.go:454-477; ev-7c039de2ef44559b67ae). Thus authenticated repository readers, including principals below issue write access, are not source-visiblely denied merely for lacking issue-unit write permission. Behavior is conditional on passing the route's token, archive and reader controls and on creation-related operations succeeding.

paths.explanation: For an authenticated caller that passes reqToken and reqRepoReader(unit.TypeIssues), on a non-archived repository, CreateIssue reaches NewIssue regardless of the result of CanWrite(unit.TypeIssues). If NewIssue succeeds, the issue creation effect is performed on ctx.Repo.Repository. The CanWrite=false branch changes optional fields rather than denying creation.
